<lines>: Serve the create+backtest tools over stdio MCP (for Claude / an agent)
--addr <HOST:PORT>           the vike-datahub the data tools dial [default: config.datahub_addr, then 127.0.0.1:7878]
--backtest-addr <HOST:PORT>  the backtesthub the run_* tools dial [default: config.backtest_addr, then 127.0.0.1:7880]
--node <HOST:PORT>           the vike-tradehub the trade tools control [default: config.node_addr]
--profile <PROFILE>          which tools are served: full (the default) | read-only | offline
--deny-tool <NAME>           withhold one tool by name; repeatable. A name this server does not serve is refused
--trace                      record the agent transcript (arguments redacted) under <project>/settings/state/agent
--trace-dir <DIR>            record the agent transcript exactly there
--unattended                 no person attends this session: every set_setting is refused; other writes keep their preview gate
